summary: Session 15 (self-hosted migration) regression pass. New /api/health endpoint returns 200 {status:ok,db:connected} on both localhost and public URL. All seed logins (superadmin/adminA/A1), invalid Google session -> 401 (Session 14 regression), /api/customers?sort=recent|debt (Session 13 regression), /api/auth/logout, and CORS preflight all working. Frontend /manifest.json returns 200 with valid PWA JSON; /login renders, login-google-button present, username/password submit with superadmin/super123 successfully navigates to /dashboard. 9/9 pytest tests passed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use style.boxShadow (RN Web migration). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up. Reference: React Native components across app using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents. Reference: components passing pointerEvents as a prop.

Console warning: Animated useNativeDriver not supported on web preview; falls back to JS-based animation. Consider guarding useNativeDriver by Platform.OS !== 'web' or removing it for web-only pages to silence noise. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated RN shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Migrate pointerEvents prop usages to style.pointerEvents.
(Optional) Gate Animated useNativeDriver:true behind Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence the RCTAnimation warning on the web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1886 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, customers, orders, health) as the codebase grows beyond a single file.

/api/health returns 200 even when DB is unreachable (returns {status:degraded}). This is fine for a liveness probe but means external orchestrators using strict 2xx-based readiness will still consider the app healthy during DB outages. Consider returning 503 for the degraded branch if this endpoint is also used as a readiness probe.
